title: Cessna 400 Corvalis TT
notice: The aircraft's own checklist is inside its encrypted archive and was not read. The steps come from the checklist texts and tooltips the aircraft ships in plain text (1700 RPM, 2600 RPM, 75 and 110 KIAS, flaps up at 400 ft and 95 KIAS, IDLE CUTOFF, the primer, the backup fuel pumps) and from the usual order for a single-engine piston; each step says which. Not a substitute for the aircraft's manual. The guide has not been run on the aircraft and none of its controls is marked verified; the ticks read standard simulation variables that the aircraft may not drive.
sources: en-us.locpak of Official2024/Steam/microsoft-aircraft-c400-corvalis (minimal.fsarchive): the aircraft's tooltips and the texts of its checklist
the usual procedure order for a single-engine piston aircraft with a constant-speed propeller
